parameters.componentSubtitle: A single tab, meant to be placed inside a Tabs component.

description.component: Renders a single nav-link list item. Place one or more inside a Tabs component's items slot — as a plain filter/navigation link (url), or as a real Bootstrap JS tab (pane_id).

url.name: URL
url.description: Where this tab links to. Used as a plain navigation link when Pane ID is empty.

pane_id.name: Pane ID
pane_id.description: Turns this tab into a real Bootstrap JS tab (only matters for the no-JS render — tabs.js promotes plain links automatically).

is_active.name: Active
is_active.description: Whether this tab is the current/active one.
